dedupe_keys.name: videopipe qv pipe and cctv pipe sewer inspection video datasets

description: VideoPipe produced two industrial video datasets for understanding urban pipe inspection: QV-Pipe for classifying defects in inspection videos and CCTV-Pipe for locating defects in time. CCTV-Pipe holds 575 videos (87 hours) from real-world urban pipe systems, with professional engineers annotating a single frame for each defect across 16 structural and functional defect categories, checked over several rounds. Coverage is real urban pipe networks, with street, city and other private information deleted. Access is free for academic research after signing a copyright form. Caveats: the defect categories are long-tailed (8 to 2,770 examples each), the location of the networks is withheld, and the page does not name the institution behind the data. Simulation uses: training and testing defect detection that feeds sewer condition and deterioration models. Related records: the Bellinge urban drainage dataset (data-bellinge-urban-drainage-dataset).
